title: Ideal Airspeed Correction
text: Calculate equivalent airspeed (EAS), calibrated airspeed (CAS), or true airspeed (TAS) from each other, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Units} sets Units Metric; {Airspeed input}, {Airspeed output}, {Method}, {Subsonic airspeeds only} uses with subsonic airspeed and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Airspeed input
params.values: Airspeed input type TAS (default) | EAS | CAS

params.name: Airspeed output
params.values: Airspeed output type EAS (default) | CAS | TAS

params.name: Method
params.values: Method for computing conversion factor Table Lookup (default) | Equation

params.name: Subsonic airspeeds only
params.values: Use with subsonic airspeed off (default) | on

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
